title: Useful metrics and metrics that turn into theatre

videos.script: Four hundred tests run last month. Ninety-five percent passed. Zero defects open. Every number on the dashboard is green. And a customer still paid the wrong price on Sunday. {{dashboard}} A number is worth keeping when it answers a question somebody needs to decide something. Ask of every one: what would change if this number changed? {{question}} And never rank people by it. When a measure becomes a target, people work on the measure. Smaller tests, split defect reports, cards moved to done before they are tested. {{goodhart}} Cine Aurora keeps three numbers. Defects that reached customers. The share found before release, sixty-seven percent. And how long a price defect stays open. Each shown with the defects behind it. {{three}} That is the course. Prevent what you can, detect what you cannot, and make sure nobody ships without knowing what they are shipping. {{end}}
